panels.title: Requests per connection by route
panels.description: Top 10 routes by requests per backend connection. Routes polled faster than the idle timeout reuse well.

panels.title: Backend connection closes per hour
panels.description: Idle: Envoy closed an unused connection. Client left: dropped mid-request. Closed by backend: it hung up first, WebSockets included.

panels.title: Connect time
panels.description: Time to open a backend connection: typical and slowest 1 %.

panels.title: Backend connection lifetime
panels.description: How long closed backend connections stayed open. Lives near the idle timeout mean polling just misses reuse.

panels.title: Queued requests per hour
panels.description: Requests that waited for a new backend connection, and those cancelled or failed while waiting.

panels.title: Bytes buffered from backends
panels.description: Response bytes held because the client reads slower than the backend sends.

panels.title: Backend read pauses per second
panels.description: Times per second Envoy paused a backend because the client side was full. Chatty but harmless while streams play smoothly.
